name: Shotframe
alt: Screenshot of the Shotframe app showing a laptop mockup on a purple gradient background
summary: A small React app that turns a plain screenshot into a clean device mockup in seconds.
points: The problem: making a good mockup meant opening Photoshop or Figma every single time
Mockups matter because people judge a design faster when they see it on a real-looking laptop or phone, not as a flat screenshot
Now it's drop in a screenshot, pick a device and background, and download a sharp PNG
